release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.2.9

• **Fixed Mobile Theme Switching**: Choosing any Dark or Light theme in Settings on mobile now applies immediately across all surfaces, clears conflicting overrides, and persists across restarts.
• **Security Hardening**: Removed shell cmd invocation in Windows updater, enforced HTTPS/loopback URL validation across updates and addons, locked Android Google login WebView to trusted auth domains, hardened Android file-open cache paths, and improved crash-log credential redaction.
• **Immersive Minimalist Car Mode (Android Auto)**: Added responsive landscape/portrait layouts, OLED ambient halo, -15s/+15s quick skip, swipe gestures, and a driver-safe Up Next Queue sheet, Like & Shuffle dock.
• **Expanded Addons Hub (Amazon Music & More)**: Added Amazon Music, Apple Music, Spotify, Tidal, Bandcamp, SoundCloud & Qobuz catalog handoff addons plus Custom Addon creation (HTTPS search templates & Lossless JSON Modules) alongside all 9 built-in Argon plugins.
• **Upgraded Explore, Playlists, Library, Home & Scroll Type**: Visual Explore mood/genre cards, live-highlighted Playlist track rows + 2x2 Library playlist collages, Scroll Type setting (Bouncing/Clamping/Snap), and pause/resume icon state fixes.
